label: Receive Email
description: Fires an execution when an email lands in the connected mailbox's inbox. The mailbox is watched over IMAP (the standard held-connection protocol every mail provider serves), so no public address and no provider app are needed. The from/subject filters run before anything is emitted.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The mailbox's access (wire an EmailAccess node). Needs the connection's incoming (IMAP) server, which is what reading mail uses.

inputs.name: fromContains
inputs.label: From contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the sender contains this
inputs.description: Only fire on messages whose From header contains this text. Leave empty for any sender.

inputs.name: subjectContains
inputs.label: Subject contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the subject contains this
inputs.description: Only fire on messages whose subject contains this text. Leave empty for any subject.

outputs.name: messageId
outputs.description: The message's Message-ID header: hand it to SendEmail's replyToMessageId to answer in the same thread.
